cases.purpose: With stand-ins allowed and claimed, every property holds.
With stand-ins forbidden by policy, no status ever rests on another platform's record.
Where the provider makes no claim of platform independence, nothing stands in.
A verified claim does let a record stand in, so the rule is live.
Planted defect: one platform's record is reused for another whatever policy says.
Planted defect: a record stands in although the claim was never verified.
Planted defect: a record stands in although the provider never claimed platform independence.
Planted defect: a stand-in is reported as passed whatever the other platform's verdict was.
Planted defect: another platform's record replaces a platform's own.
Planted defect: a status rests on another platform's record and the report does not say so.
Planted defect: one platform alone is reported as reproduced.
Planted defect: two platforms disagree and it is not a failure.
